hero.desc: An open-source Minecraft launcher with multiple instance management, mod and resource installation, multiplayer, and plugin extensions.
hero.caption: EuoraCraft Launcher · Home interface

stories.title: Complex management. Simply done.
stories.desc: From organizing instances to playing with friends, everything has its place.

instances.label: Instances & game management
instances.title: Manage game instances separately
instances.desc: Create separate instances for game versions and modpacks, with their own mods, resource packs, worlds, servers, and screenshots.
instances.alt: ECL instance management showing isolated game instances and versions

mods.label: Mods & resources
mods.title: Find and install mods and resources
mods.desc: Search Modrinth and CurseForge for mods, resource packs, shaders and modpacks. Filter by game version and loader, then manage installed resources and their updates.
mods.alt: ECL mod search with its search bar and resource results

connect.label: Multiplayer
connect.title: Create a room and play together
connect.desc: Create or join multiplayer rooms in the launcher and connect through a virtual network to play with friends.
connect.alt: ECL multiplayer lobby with rooms and virtual networking

plugins.label: Plugin extensions
plugins.title: Extend the launcher with plugins
plugins.desc: Install .eclplugin packages to extend authentication, multiplayer, crash analysis and the interface. Plugins run in the launcher process; install only plugins from sources you trust.
plugins.alt: ECL plugin management with installed plugins and installation controls

opensource.title: View the source and contribute
opensource.desc: ECL is open source under GPL-3.0. Explore the source and report issues or suggestions on GitHub. User guides and development resources are available in the documentation.

cta.title: Download EuoraCraft Launcher
cta.desc: Choose a package for your system and architecture, and read the release notes before installing.

featuresPage.title: Features
featuresPage.desc: Explore current ECL capabilities, from instances, resources and Java management to multiplayer, plugins and crash analysis.
featuresPage.versionNote: These features describe the current development version. Older release packages may differ; check the notes for the version you download.

download.title: Download
download.desc: Get the latest version from GitHub Releases. Please read the docs and tutorials before your first use.

latest.title: Get a release
latest.desc: Browse releases and prereleases and choose a package for your system and architecture. Features and update support depend on the version.

update.title: Update method
update.desc: Check updates in Settings → About. Packaged versions with built-in update support can download an update and restart after confirmation. Source runs, alpha builds and older versions may require a manual update from Releases.

download.platformNote: Available platforms and architectures depend on the assets attached to the selected release.

install.title: Get started
steps: Choose a version in Releases and read its release notes.
Download the installer or archive matching your system and architecture.
Follow the release instructions to install or extract it. Check the docs before your first use.

release.noReleases: No public releases are available yet. Please check back later.
release.error: Unable to check releases. Try again or visit GitHub Releases.
release.errorCached: Unable to refresh. The last successfully checked release is shown below.
release.noNotes: Release notes have not been provided for this version.
release.notesUnavailable: Release notes are unavailable. You can view the release page instead.

docs.desc: Start with the official documentation site, or explore the theme, plugin package, multiplayer extension and command-line guides.

license.title: Open source license
license.text: The source code is licensed under {code}; the logo and image assets follow {images}. The source is hosted on GitHub.

showcase.title: Meet ECL, without a download.
showcase.desc: Explore the interface and workflows in the standalone frontend demo. All data is for demonstration; no Minecraft downloads or launches take place.
showcase.note: This is an independent demo; interactions are for display only and will not actually download or start Minecraft.

unconfigured.title: Preview site not configured yet
unconfigured.desc: A launcher frontend demo window will be embedded here. Deploy the launcher's build:showcase output to a static host, then set that URL in the SHOWCASE_URL repository variable so it is injected into the site at build time.

footer.copyright: Code is under {license}; the logo and images follow {images}.

themeDesigner.title: Theme design guide
themeDesigner.desc: Visually edit themes in a dedicated window and export .ecltheme theme bundles.

pluginConnector.title: Multiplayer connector protocol
pluginConnector.desc: Extend the multiplayer lobby with custom protocols via plugins.

instanceCompat.title: Instance compatibility
instanceCompat.desc: Read read-only instance metadata from other launchers for instance compatibility.

guide.title: Official documentation
guide.desc: The main destination for user guides, development notes and technical tutorials.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.desc: Learn the basics of accounts, instances, resources and multiplayer, and review system and version information before you begin.

pluginPackages.title: .eclplugin package format
pluginPackages.desc: Plugin archives, dependency locks, offline wheels, installation and the actual runtime boundaries.

themePlugin.title: Theme bundles & extension protocol
themePlugin.desc: Learn about .ecltheme bundles, appearance capabilities and the theme plugin protocol.

cli.title: Command line & quick launch
cli.desc: Command-line options, instance launch workflows and script integration.

instances.title: Instances & game management
instances.desc: Manage multiple game directories and instances, configure Java, memory and launch arguments per instance, and organize worlds, servers, screenshots and logs.

resources.title: Mods & resource search
resources.desc: Search Modrinth and CurseForge for mods, resource packs, shaders, data packs and modpacks. Filter by game version and loader, then manage installed resources and updates.

java.title: Java runtimes
java.desc: Discover local Java installations, download and install Temurin, inspect versions and architectures, and select a suitable runtime for each instance.

users.title: Accounts & skins
users.desc: Microsoft, offline and external authentication accounts, with centralized account management, a skin wardrobe and character appearance controls.

lobby.title: Multiplayer & virtual networking
lobby.desc: Create or join EasyTier multiplayer rooms, inspect nodes and network status, and extend connector protocols through plugins.

plugin.title: Plugin installation & extensions
plugin.desc: Install .eclplugin packages to extend authentication, networking, crash analysis and UI slots. Installation checks source confirmation and dependencies; a restart is usually required.

palette.title: Classic / Folia appearance
palette.desc: Light and dark modes, accent colors, Aurora, image and video backgrounds, and Classic / Folia surfaces. Export theme bundles with the visual theme designer.

crash.title: Crash analysis
crash.desc: Collect exit information and crash logs, then analyze likely causes using rules and mod information to help diagnose problems.

tools.title: Practical tools
tools.desc: Custom file downloads, Minecraft skin PNG avatar cropping and export, and NAT type detection, together in the More tools page.

updates.title: Version checks & updates
updates.desc: Check launcher updates in Settings → About. Packaged versions with built-in update support can download an update and restart after confirmation.

i18n.title: Multilingual interface
i18n.desc: Switch interface languages and manage accounts, games, multiplayer and settings in a language you know.

seo.title: EuoraCraft Launcher · A thoughtful start to Minecraft
seo.description: EuoraCraft Launcher is an open-source Minecraft launcher with instance and Java management, mod and resource search, multiplayer, plugins, crash analysis and personal themes.
